svg.text: Sleeve 22 OD x 15 ID, 51 long, on a 3 mm base, on two 4 x 4 legs 5 tall

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 16 apart. Print upright; the legs need no support.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 4 mm lead hole in the base, 5 mm off centre, for the cell's lower lead.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: drops into the tube and stands on the top of the fin spigot,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: legs either side of the probe pocket, so the cell centre is 62 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: below grade. It lifts out through the 28 mm hole in the head floor.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Tie a loop of strong cord through the top of the sleeve to lift it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the 14500 cell slides in by hand; the holder drops through
